title: valeriana effusa var. genuina
intro: Valeriana effusa var. genuina, commonly known as Mexican valerian, is a perennial plant species within the Valerianaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety, stress, and insomnia, promoting relaxation, and acting as a natural sedative. The therapeutic actions of Mexican valerian are attributed to its ability to interact with the nervous system, inducing a calming effect and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valepotriates, isovaleramide, and valerenic acid, which contribute to its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties.
